identity.description: An attacker creates a remote scheduled task using schtasks.exe to establish persistence on a target system. Cortex should detect this behavior as an uncommon remote scheduled task creation. The attack involves creating a task on a remote host using schtasks with a command that downloads and executes a payload from a test-net C2 server.

biocs.name: Uncommon Remote Scheduled Task Creation
biocs.description: Detection of scheduled task creation on remote host using schtasks.exe with unusual parameters
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'schtasks.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'schtasks'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'services.exe'
| filter dst_ip = '192.0.2.10'

abiocs.name: Remote Scheduled Task Creation with Encoded Command
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation indicating creation of a scheduled task with encoded command on remote system
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'schtasks.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'schtasks'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'services.exe'
| filter dst_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter action_file_path contains '-EncodedCommand'

xql_queries.name: Scheduled Task Creation on Remote Host
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'schtasks.exe'
| filter dst_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter action_file_path contains '/s'
| filter action_file_path contains '/tr'
| filter action_file_path contains 'powershell.exe'
